benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank account
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Must be Indian citizen. Excludes institutional landholders, government employees with income >₹10,000/month, income taxpayers, doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs.
documents: Aadhaar card, land records (Khasra/Khatauni), bank account linked to Aadhaar, mobile number
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmkisan.gov.in. Village level workers (patwari) can also register. Existing beneficiaries auto-renewed annually.

benefit: Coverage for crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases. Premium: 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for commercial/horticulture crops. Government pays rest.
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) growing notified crops. Must apply before sowing season cutoff date (usually 15 days before sowing).
documents: Aadhaar, land records, bank account, sown crop declaration, village/survey number
how_to_apply: Through bank (for loanee farmers — auto-enrolled), CSC centers, insurance company agents, or pmfby.gov.in portal
contact: National helpline: 14447. State nodal officers available district-wise.

benefit: Free soil testing every 2 years. Card showing 12 soil parameters (NPK, pH, micronutrients, organic carbon). Crop-wise fertilizer recommendations.
eligibility: All farmers in India. One card per holding every 2 years. No income restriction.
documents: Land ownership proof or lease agreement, Aadhaar, contact details
how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), Agriculture Department office, or soil testing laboratory. Soil Health Card portal: soilhealth.dac.gov.in
contact: State Agriculture Department. Helpline varies by state.

benefit: Online platform connecting farmers to 1,000+ mandis across India. Transparent price discovery, reduced middlemen, online payment. Better price realization reported at 10-15% above local mandi.
eligibility: Any farmer who wishes to sell produce. Farmers must be registered with local APMC mandi.
documents: Aadhaar, bank account, mandi registration, mobile number
how_to_apply: Register at enam.gov.in or through local APMC mandi office. Mobile app available: eNAM.

benefit: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest (effective 4% after 3% interest subvention). Covers crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of allied activities.
eligibility: All farmers — individual, joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers. Also applicable to SHG and JLG farmers.
documents: Land records, identity proof (Aadhaar/voter ID), address proof, passport photo
how_to_apply: Apply at any nationalized bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank. NABARD oversees the scheme.

benefit: Funding for farm mechanization, irrigation, organic farming, horticulture development, livestock, fisheries. State governments get grants for district agriculture plans.
eligibility: State governments propose projects; individual farmers benefit through state implementation. No direct application by farmers — district agriculture officers submit plans.
documents: Depends on state scheme under RKVY. Typically land records, Aadhaar.
how_to_apply: Contact district Agriculture Officer or Block Development Office. Many states run sub-schemes under RKVY for subsidy on tractors, drip irrigation, greenhouse.
contact: District Agriculture Officer / State Agriculture Department

benefit: Subsidy for micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler): 45-55% for small/marginal farmers, 35-45% for others. Increases water use efficiency by 40-50%.
eligibility: Farmers with own or leased land. Small and marginal farmers get higher subsidy rates.
documents: Land records, Aadhaar, bank account, crop details
how_to_apply: Apply through state Agriculture or Horticulture Department. Portal: pmksy.gov.in

scheme_name: MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture)
benefit: 50-75% subsidy on establishment of orchards, polyhouses, shade nets, cold storage, packhouses, processing units. Technology missions for fruits, vegetables, floriculture.
eligibility: Farmers growing horticulture crops (fruits, vegetables, flowers, spices, mushrooms). Priority to small and marginal farmers.
documents: Land ownership proof, bank account, crop plan, Aadhaar
how_to_apply: State Horticulture Mission office in each district. Portal: midh.gov.in
contact: State Horticulture Mission. Helpline varies by state.
